themes.summary: Several buyers say AI output and UI instructions appear in Chinese despite English settings, plus dragging navigation is broken.

hits.quote: AI Explore option gives the results in Chinese instead of English.
furthermore many of the responses are in Chinese!
There are few small issues like chinese words showing up while using AI.
AI often replies in other languages.
Dragging the mind-map to navigate around is not very responsive
some instructions still in simplified chinese, even my default language is set english

themes.summary: Many buyers say the tool quickly turns prompts, PDFs and documents into clear, useful mind maps.

hits.quote: Perfect. Does what it promises to do.
i uploaded a pdf and it gave a colorful mind map i read before reading the file

Great job on the tool, as I will be using it a bit.
